meta.name: review-responder
meta.description: Process and respond to code review feedback. Use after receiving PR comments from GitHub, feedback from disconnected-code-review skill, or any code review input. Walks through changes one-by-one with user approval.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把评审意见逐条转化为代码修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果收到大量代码评审意见,想按步骤逐一落实
copy.tagline_en: Turn code review comments into concrete code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you receive many comments on your pull requests and need a step-by-step way to address them

howto.what: 收到代码评审意见后,Claude 先汇总成问题清单,再逐条询问你「应用、跳过、讨论」,按你的选择改代码。若意见来自 GitHub PR,处理完可代你回复评论。
howto.when: 当 Claude 收到 GitHub PR 评论、disconnected-code-review 技能反馈或其他代码评审意见时触发;它会逐条处理改动,每次修改都需要你确认。

say.text: 我刚收到一条 GitHub 评审意见,帮我逐条处理。
say.note: Claude 会先给出评审摘要和问题清单。

say.text: 这条 SQL 注入问题,跳过,不改。
say.note: 它会记录跳过并继续下一项。

say.text: 都处理完了,帮我把已应用的改动回复到 PR。
say.note: 它汇总行动摘要并询问是否回复 GitHub 评论。

howto.what_en: On receiving code review feedback, Claude summarizes the issues, then walks each one asking Apply/Skip/Discuss and edits code accordingly. If the review came from GitHub PR comments, it can reply to those comments after processing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude receives GitHub PR comments, feedback from disconnected-code-review, or other code review input. It then processes changes one-by-one with user approval.

say_en.text: I just got a GitHub review. Walk me through it item by item.
say_en.note: Claude summarizes the review and lists the changes.

say_en.text: Skip the SQL injection fix; don't apply it.
say_en.note: It records the skip and moves to the next item.

say_en.text: Post replies to the PR for the changes we applied.
say_en.note: It summarizes actions and asks before replying to GitHub.
